topic: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks coding tasks: the knobs that cut the waste
title: Qwen3.8-27B overthinks your code
description: Working value; the package stage overwrites.
hook_candidates: Three moves and your coder stops stalling tonight.
Your coder isn't slow. Its dial is glued.
You ask for one edit. It thinks for twenty-one minutes.
Qwen3.8-27B thinks itself out of answers.
19.4% of xhigh calls came back empty.
One prompt. Fourteen minutes of thinking.
Set two flags tonight, cut the thinking eight times.
xhigh or medium? Eight times the tokens decides.
narration_full: Three moves and your coder stops stalling tonight. Twenty-one minutes thinking on one prompt: that's your local Qwen's factory default. Step one: set reasoning effort, the dial for how long it thinks, to medium. Qwen three point eight ships on x high, the maximum. Nobody asked it to. Step two: cap the thinking; the flag is only a suggestion. A budget is a hard stop: two thousand forty-eight reasoning tokens. Step three: paste the closing line. When the cap hits, it tells the model: act on the code already read. Same model, same issues: sixty-four percent fixed instead of fifty-two, on a quarter of the thinking. It just writes the code.

scenes.narration: Step one: set reasoning effort, the dial for how long it thinks, to medium. Qwen three point eight ships on x high, the maximum. Nobody asked it to.

On 'the maximum' a small tag reading 'shipped here' fades in beside the xhigh stop.

scenes.narration: Step two: cap the thinking; the flag is only a suggestion. A budget is a hard stop: two thousand forty-eight reasoning tokens.
scenes.visual_brief: Giant number layout. On 'cap the thinking' the digits 2048 scale in large at center with the config line thinking_budget = 2048 beneath. Below it a token bar scales in and keeps growing; on 'hard stop' a vertical cut line fades in across the bar and the bar clips at that line.

scenes.narration: Step three: paste the closing line. When the cap hits, it tells the model: act on the code already read.
scenes.visual_brief: Diagram flow. On 'the closing line' a spent-token node fades in left, labeled 'cap hit'. On 'it tells the model' a quote card fades in center carrying the closing sentence. On 'act on the code' a code-editor node rises in place right, one line highlighting as an edit lands. Thin connectors fade in between the nodes.

scenes.narration: Same model, same issues: sixty-four percent fixed instead of fifty-two, on a quarter of the thinking. It just writes the code.
scenes.visual_brief: Split compare bars. On 'sixty-four percent' two bars rise in place under the header: the taller left bar marked 64 and labeled dwim, the right bar marked 52 and labeled OpenCode. On 'a quarter of the thinking' a thin underbar scales in beneath each bar, the left one a quarter the width of the right. On 'It just writes the code' the frame holds one beat and the wordmark fades in at the corner.

notes_for_review: Spoken numbers: twenty-one minutes (Willison prompt), two thousand forty-eight token cap (dwim), sixty-four vs fifty-two percent resolved and a quarter of the thinking (dwim vs OpenCode). Four key numbers, each with unit and referent; nothing else numeric is spoken.; Payoff evidence is dwim's cap-plus-closing-line eval; the effort flag (step one) was not part of that eval, so the payoff says 'same model, same issues' rather than claiming all three moves produced the sixty-four. Confirm that framing.; Qwen's model-card caveat that lower effort can raise total tokens via retries in multi-turn agentic runs is cut for word budget; the honesty beat is compressed into 'the flag is only a suggestion'. Flag if the retry caveat must go back in.; Single wry beat is 'Nobody asked it to.' in scene two; none in hook or payoff.; TTS check: 'x high' is the xhigh effort level.
